seasonRead.headline: 2017–18: Two-way puck pressure makes an outlier map
paragraphs: The 2017–18 model learned 5 forward styles. Puck-Pressure Two-Way Creator led with 377 of 467 forwards (80.7%), followed by High-Touch Puck Mover at 11.1%.
Puck-Pressure Two-Way Creator contains 80.7% of forwards and leads the runner-up by 69.6 points. The other four learned styles divide only 19.3%, making this a nearly single-center classification.

seasonRead.headline: 2017–18: Defense-first profiles dominate the split
paragraphs: The 2017–18 model learned 4 defense styles. Defensive Role Defenseman led with 125 of 255 defenders (49.0%), followed by Shot-Blocking Defensive Defenseman at 34.9%.

Defensive Role Defenseman and Shot-Blocking Defensive Defenseman combine for 83.9% of defenders. The top three reach 99.6% across four styles, so almost the entire map sits inside a defense-first hierarchy.
